definition: To believe something is true without proof

definition: A result or effect of an action

definition: The system by which a country manages its money and trade

definition: The natural world around us, including air, water, and land

definition: To have an effect on someone or something

definition: To discuss something to try to reach an agreement

definition: A chance to do something good or useful
